notes.title: Steam Store Page Major Update ✨ Theme Song & PV Now Available!
notes.content: [p]We’ve made a major update to the Steam store page for our game![/p][p]The key visual, screenshots, and game description have all been refreshed, and new sections introducing the characters and cast have been added.[/p][p]We’ve also released the promotional video (PV) featuring the theme song “Melody of the Night Sky ～Miracle of the Cherry Blossoms～” sung by Rin Kurusu, who voices Cherry![/p][p]Get an early taste of the game’s world through this special video—be sure to check it out! 🌸[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="feOr1gY963I;full"][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: - The key visual, screenshots, and game description have all been refreshed, and new sections introducing the characters and cast have been added.
- We’ve also released the promotional video (PV) featuring the theme song “Melody of the Night Sky ～Miracle of the Cherry Blossoms～” sung by Rin Kurusu, who voices Cherry!
